title: Module 9 · Stroke
intro: Stroke alert checks, tenecteplase and alteplase dosing and safety, contraindications and imaging selected windows, angioedema, post lytic care, DAPT, ICH reversal and BP, and nimodipine after SAH.

cases.title: Stroke alert: the pharmacist checks
cases.stem: Stroke alert. Last known well 2 hours ago. Weight 82 kg (measured). BP 196/108. Glucose 132. On no anticoagulants.

steps.q: Can the thrombolytic be given now?

options.t: Not yet: BP must be below 185/110 first
Not yet: BP must be below 180/105 first
options.why: 180/105 is the limit after thrombolysis, for 24 hours.

options.t: Not yet: BP must be below 140/90 first
Yes: BP limits apply only to alteplase
Labetalol 10 to 20 mg IV over 1 to 2 min, may repeat
Nicardipine 5 mg/h, up 2.5 mg/h every 5 to 15 min
Clevidipine 1 to 2 mg/h, titrate to max 21 mg/h
Nifedipine 10 mg sublingual, may repeat once
Hydralazine 20 mg IV every 20 min as first line
options.why: Not a listed first line agent; unpredictable.

options.t: Glucose below 50 can mimic a stroke
options.why: Correct it first; above 400 also mimics.

options.t: Glucose above 140 forbids thrombolysis
options.why: Hyperglycemia is treated, not a contraindication.

options.t: Glucose sets the thrombolytic dose
Glucose must be below 180 to treat

cases.pearl: **Before lytics: BP below 185/110, glucose checked, weight, last anticoagulant dose.**

cases.title: Tenecteplase dose
cases.stem: BP is now 176/98. The team chooses tenecteplase. Weight 82 kg.

options.t: 0.25 mg/kg bolus, max 25 mg: 20.5 mg
0.5 mg/kg bolus, max 50 mg: 41 mg
0.4 mg/kg bolus, max 40 mg: 32.8 mg
options.why: Studied in EXTEND IA TNK part 2; no benefit over 0.25.

options.t: 0.9 mg/kg, max 90 mg: 73.8 mg

steps.q: Tenecteplase or alteplase per the 2026 guideline?

options.t: Either agent, within the 4.5 hour window
Alteplase only; tenecteplase is off label
Tenecteplase only after 3 hours
Tenecteplase only with an LVO

steps.q: What safety steps do you take when preparing it?

options.t: Double check drug and dose; waste the excess
options.why: Tenecteplase and alteplase names look alike.

options.t: Reconstitute with D5W and shake well
options.why: Use the supplied diluent; swirl gently.

options.t: Draw up the full 50 mg vial to save time
Give over 1 minute, followed by an infusion
options.why: That is alteplase; tenecteplase is one bolus.

cases.pearl: **TNK stroke: 0.25 mg/kg, max 25 mg, over 5 seconds. Never the cardiac dose.**

cases.title: Alteplase math

steps.q: What are the total, bolus and infusion amounts?

options.t: 63 mg total; 6.3 mg bolus; 56.7 mg over 60 min
90 mg total; 9 mg bolus; 81 mg over 60 min
options.why: 90 mg is the max, for 100 kg or more.

options.t: 63 mg total; 15 mg bolus; 48 mg over 60 min
options.why: A 15 mg bolus is the STEMI regimen.

options.t: 70 mg total; 7 mg bolus; 63 mg over 60 min

steps.q: What happens to the extra drug in the vial?

options.t: Remove and waste it before hanging the bag
options.why: Prevents giving more than the calculated dose.

options.t: Infuse the vial remainder after the dose
Return the vial to the stroke box
Save it for a repeat bolus at 24 hours

cases.pearl: **Alteplase: 0.9 mg/kg (max 90), 10% bolus, 90% over 60 minutes. Waste the excess.**

workup.calc: 0.9 x 70 = **63 mg** total; bolus 6.3 mg over 1 minute; 56.7 mg over 60 minutes; waste 37 mg from a 100 mg vial before hanging.

cases.title: Who should NOT get a thrombolytic?

steps.q: Which patients should not get a thrombolytic?

options.t: Apixaban taken 3 hours ago
Platelets 72,000
INR 2.4 on warfarin
Mild, nondisabling symptoms
LKW 2 h, BP 170/90, disabling deficit
Glucose 220 that is being treated

steps.q: A patient woke up with symptoms (unknown onset). Is thrombolysis ever possible?

options.t: Yes, with advanced imaging, up to about 9 h
options.why: DWI FLAIR or perfusion mismatch (2026 guideline).

options.t: Yes, if it is less than 24 hours since bedtime
options.why: Needs imaging selection; 24 h is a thrombectomy window.

options.t: No; unknown onset is always excluded
options.why: Imaging selected patients may be treated.

options.t: Yes, if NIHSS is above 25
options.why: Severity does not define eligibility here.

cases.pearl: **No lytic: recent DOAC, INR above 1.7, platelets below 100k, mild nondisabling symptoms.**

cases.title: Tongue swelling during alteplase
cases.stem: The patient takes lisinopril. Tongue and lips are swelling.

options.t: Orolingual angioedema: more bradykinin
options.why: Plasmin raises bradykinin; ACE inhibitors block its breakdown.

options.t: A histamine allergy to the alteplase
An allergy to the saline diluent
Hemorrhage into the tongue
Stop it; steroid, H1 and H2 blockers; epi if worse
options.why: Icatibant or C1 esterase inhibitor may be considered; protect the airway.

options.t: Continue the infusion; give diphenhydramine
Stop it and give FFP and cryoprecipitate
Stop it and give tranexamic acid 1 g IV

cases.pearl: **Lytic + ACE inhibitor + swelling: stop, steroid, H1, H2, epi if worse.**

options.t: No antithrombotics for 24 h after thrombolysis
Aspirin is fine; only hold enoxaparin
Enoxaparin is fine; only hold aspirin
Aspirin dose should be 81 mg, not 325

steps.q: What BP goal applies for the first 24 hours?

options.t: Below 180/105
Below 185/110
Below 140/90
Below 220/120

cases.pearl: **After lytic: BP below 180/105, no antithrombotics for 24 hours.**

cases.title: Minor stroke: DAPT
cases.stem: Minor ischemic stroke, NIHSS 3, no thrombolytic, no atrial fibrillation.

options.t: Aspirin + clopidogrel 21 days, then one agent
options.why: Clopidogrel 300 to 600 mg load, then 75 mg (CHANCE, POINT).

options.t: Aspirin + clopidogrel for 12 months
options.why: 12 months is an ACS duration; more bleeding.

options.t: Aspirin + clopidogrel for 90 days
options.why: POINT used 90 days; most benefit was early, bleeding later.

options.t: Apixaban 5 mg BID for secondary prevention
options.why: No atrial fibrillation; antiplatelets are used.

options.t: High intensity statin
Glucose 140 to 180 in hospital
VTE prophylaxis once safe
Routine seizure prophylaxis
Glucose 80 to 110 in hospital

cases.pearl: **Minor stroke: DAPT 21 days, high intensity statin.**

cases.title: ICH on apixaban
cases.stem: ICH. Apixaban last taken 5 hours ago. SBP 196. Weight 80 kg.

options.t: 4F-PCC per protocol (often 50 units/kg)
options.why: Andexanet withdrawn from the US in 2025.

options.t: Andexanet alfa, low dose regimen
Idarucizumab 5 g IV
Vitamin K 10 mg IV slowly
SBP about 140 mmHg
SBP below 185 mmHg
options.why: The ischemic stroke pre thrombolysis gate.

options.t: SBP below 160 mmHg
SBP below 110 mmHg

steps.q: Should she get platelets if she also takes aspirin?

options.t: No, unless she goes to neurosurgery
Yes, 1 unit for every aspirin user
Yes, if platelets are below 150,000
Desmopressin 0.4 mcg/kg is required

cases.pearl: **ICH: reverse fast, SBP to 140 (not below 130), no platelets for antiplatelet bleeds unless surgery.**

cases.title: ICH on warfarin or heparin
cases.stem: Two patients with ICH: (A) warfarin, INR 3.1, 90 kg; (B) heparin infusion at 1,400 units/h for the last 3 hours.

options.t: 4F-PCC 25 units/kg (2,250 units) + vitamin K 10 mg
4F-PCC 35 units/kg (3,150 units) + vitamin K 10 mg
4F-PCC 50 units/kg (4,500 units) + vitamin K 10 mg
FFP 2 units with vitamin K 10 mg IV
About 42 mg (1 mg per 100 units, last 2 to 3 h)
About 14 mg (1 mg per 100 units, last hour)
About 84 mg (1 mg per 50 units, last 3 h)
A fixed 100 mg dose for all patients
options.why: Above the max; excess protamine is an anticoagulant.

cases.pearl: **Warfarin: PCC by INR + vit K. Heparin: protamine 1 mg per 100 units (last 2 to 3 h, max 50).**

cases.title: Nimodipine after SAH
cases.stem: Aneurysmal SAH. The patient has an NG tube. A nurse asks to draw nimodipine liquid into a syringe.

options.t: 60 mg every 4 h for 21 days
options.why: 30 mg every 2 hours if BP drops (nimodipine label).

options.t: 60 mg every 6 h for 14 days
30 mg every 8 h for 21 days
IV infusion for 21 days
options.why: No IV product in the US.

steps.q: What is the critical safety step?

options.t: Use an oral syringe that cannot connect to IV
options.why: Label it "for oral use only"; IV nimodipine deaths occurred.

options.t: Use a luer lock syringe with a red cap
Use a standard syringe and flush the line
Ask the nurse to give it slowly IV

cases.pearl: **Nimodipine 60 mg q4h x 21 days, enteral syringe only. Never IV.**
